name: Last Seen for ČSFD
author: JosefStepanek

sections.description:
Last Seen for ČSFD (formerly ČSFD Last Seen) shows the movies and TV series you have recently rated on ČSFD.cz – the Czech-Slovak Film Database – and optionally your latest reviews. Just paste the address of your ČSFD profile and the list stays up to date automatically.

Features

  • Shortcode [csfd_last_seen] – put the list into any page or post (in the block editor use the Shortcode block).
  • Widget for sidebars and other widget areas – it can use the shared settings or its own.
  • Settings page in Settings → Last Seen for ČSFD with a live preview and a “reload now” button.
  • Film colour (ČSFD average rating), release year and your star rating, just like on ČSFD.
  • Optional latest reviews with posters.
  • Data is cached (1–168 hours, default 2). If ČSFD.cz is unavailable, the last successfully loaded list is shown instead of an empty box.
  • Lightweight: the stylesheet is loaded only on pages where the list is displayed; no JavaScript on the front end.
  • The plugin interface is in Czech (as well as ČSFD.cz).

Česky

Plugin zobrazí vaše poslední hodnocení filmů a seriálů z ČSFD.cz (a volitelně i poslední recenze). Stačí v Nastavení → Last Seen for ČSFD vyplnit adresu svého profilu a výpis vložit shortcodem [csfd_last_seen] nebo widgetem „Last Seen for ČSFD“.

Shortcode attributes

All attributes are optional and override the values from Settings → Last Seen for ČSFD:

  • url – ČSFD profile address, e.g. url="https://www.csfd.cz/uzivatel/29153-joste/"
  • count – number of films (1–50)
  • reviews – number of reviews (0 = hide reviews)
  • color – show the film colour (yes / no)
  • year – show the release year (yes / no)
  • nofollow – add rel="nofollow" to the links (yes / no)
  • profile_link – show the “Můj účet na ČSFD »” link (yes / no)
  • title – heading above the list

Example: [csfd_last_seen count="5" reviews="2" title="Naposledy jsem viděl"]

For developers

  • Filter csfd_last_seen_user_agent – User-Agent sent to ČSFD.cz.
  • Filter csfd_last_seen_retry_interval – seconds before a failed download is retried (default 900).
  • The output uses the classes .csfd-last-seen, .csfd-last-seen-ratings, .csfd-last-seen-reviews and .csfd-last-seen-profile, so it is easy to restyle from your theme.

Related links

  • ČSFD.cz (data source)
  • Návod v češtině

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by ČSFD.cz.

External services

The plugin needs data from ČSFD.cz (Czech-Slovak Film Database, operated by POMO Media Group s.r.o.).

  • What is sent and when: the server of your website downloads the public pages of the ČSFD profile you enter in the settings (…/hodnoceni/ with ratings and, if reviews are enabled, …/recenze/). This happens only when the cached data expires (every 1–168 hours, as configured) or when you save the settings. Only a standard HTTP request for these public pages is sent – no data about your visitors.
  • Images: if reviews are displayed, film posters are loaded by your visitors’ browsers directly from the ČSFD image server (image.pmgstatic.com).
  • Links in the list lead to ČSFD.cz.

ČSFD.cz terms of use: https://www.csfd.cz/vseobecne-podminky-uzivani/ – privacy policy: https://www.csfd.cz/zasady-ochrany-osobnich-udaju/
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New (search for “Last Seen for ČSFD” or “csfd”), or upload the csfd-last-seen folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Last Seen for ČSFD and enter the address of your ČSFD profile, e.g. https://www.csfd.cz/uzivatel/29153-joste/.
  4. Insert the [csfd_last_seen] shortcode into a page or post, or add the “Last Seen for ČSFD” widget in Appearance → Widgets.
sections.faq:
Which profile address should I use?

Open your profile on ČSFD.cz and copy the address from the browser, e.g. https://www.csfd.cz/uzivatel/29153-joste/. Addresses of profile sub-pages (…/prehled/, …/hodnoceni/) and csfd.sk addresses work too.

I updated from version 1.x. Do I have to change anything?

No. The plugin is now called “Last Seen for ČSFD”, but it is the same plugin. Existing widgets keep their own settings and work as before. The new shared settings were pre-filled from your first widget, so the shortcode works right away. If you want a widget to follow the shared settings, tick “Použít společné nastavení” in the widget.

The list does not show my latest rating

The data is cached – by default for 2 hours. Click “Načíst znovu z ČSFD.cz” in Settings → Last Seen for ČSFD (or save the settings / the widget) to download fresh data.

The list is empty or shows an error

Check the status message in Settings → Last Seen for ČSFD. ČSFD.cz uses anti-bot protection; the plugin identifies itself with its own User-Agent, which is allowed. If ČSFD.cz is temporarily unavailable, the last successfully loaded list is shown and the download is retried in 15 minutes. An HTML comment at the end of the list also says when the data was loaded.

Can I show lists of different users?

Yes – use the url attribute of the shortcode, or give each widget its own settings.

Does it work with the block editor and block themes?

Yes. Use the Shortcode block in posts, pages and templates. In block themes without widget areas use the shortcode.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0 – 2026-11-04

  • New: settings page in Settings → Last Seen for ČSFD with live preview, status of the last download and a “reload now” button.
  • New: shortcode [csfd_last_seen] with optional attributes.
  • New: widgets can use the shared settings (“Použít společné nastavení”); existing widgets keep their own settings.
  • New: option to hide the profile link.
  • Fix: no ratings were shown – ČSFD.cz now uses anti-bot protection which denies requests without a User-Agent.
  • Fix: the widget displayed one film more than set.
  • Fix: profile addresses like …/uzivatel/29153-joste/prehled/ work.
  • Improved: when ČSFD.cz is unavailable, the last successfully loaded data is shown and the download is retried in 15 minutes.
  • Improved: data is parsed into a clean, escaped HTML structure (no ČSFD markup is copied to your site).
  • Improved: styles moved to a stylesheet loaded only where the list is displayed; layout adapts to the container width.
  • Changed: the plugin was renamed from “ČSFD Last Seen” to “Last Seen for ČSFD” (slug, shortcode and settings stay the same).
  • Changed: own star rating graphics and a new plugin icon – the plugin no longer uses any ČSFD graphics (icon font, logo).
  • Improved: uses the WordPress HTTP API; security hardening (escaping, sanitization, nonces); data is removed on uninstall.
  • Requires WordPress 5.3 and PHP 7.2 or newer.

1.9.3 – 2026-02-09

  • Added reviews display option with configurable count.
  • Improved responsive layout (flexbox).
  • Updated CSS styles and icons.
  • Changed profile link from “Starší hodnocení” to “Můj účet”.

1.9.2 – 2021-05-13

  • Localization support.

1.9.1 – 2021-05-11

  • Plugin icon added.

1.9 – 2021-05-11

  • Fixes after the new CSFD.cz design release.

1.8.2 – 2017-06-17

  • Minor code refactoring to fix some weird random bugs in the data table (fsockopen => curl).

1.8.1 – 2017-06-05

  • HTTPS redirect fix (caused no data error).

1.8 – 2016-04-09

  • Added HTTPS support, removed own star image in the settings.

1.7 – 2016-04-09

  • Code and cache refactoring.

1.6.1 – 2014-06-06

  • Change of some URLs on CSFD.cz.

1.6 – 2012-06-01

  • A few minor fixes after the changes on CSFD.cz.

1.5 – 2011-01-23

  • Changes to make this plugin prepared for the new version of CSFD.cz (now works with both – old and new).

1.4.1 – 2010-02-05

  • Major fix (during the CSFD.cz changes).

1.4 – 2009-12-27

  • Source code optimization, multiple widgets possible since now.

1.3 – 2009-12-19

  • HTML => XHTML code fix + alt added to movie color.

1.2 – 2009-12-13

  • Added many useful settings.

1.1 – 2009-12-06

  • Several bug fixes.

1.0 – 2009-12-06

  • First stable tested version.

0.9 – 2009-11-23

  • Initial release.
